launch-desk.sentence: Gloamstream is raising prices on all three of its streaming plans.
The ad-supported plan goes from $7.99 to $8.99 a month.
Current subscribers will pay the new prices from December 12.

byteward.sentence: Gloamstream is increasing the price of every plan it offers.
The Standard plan moves from $13.99 to $15.99 a month.
People who already subscribe will see the higher price starting December 12.

frametime.sentence: Gloamstream is raising prices across all three of its plans.
In our testing, the ad plan's 1080p streams averaged 4.1 Mbps.
Standard's 1080p streams averaged 7.8 Mbps, nearly double.
If you'd rather lock in today's price, annual plans bought before December 12 keep the old rate.

bench-and-bill.sentence: Gloamstream is raising prices on every plan.
Existing subscribers will pay more starting December 12.
The Subscription Exit Act requires 30 days' notice before a subscription's price goes up.
The same law requires services to let customers cancel online in two steps or fewer.
Customers who would rather stay can lock in the current price by buying an annual plan before December 12.
